name: Crowded Collect — Dues & Fundraising
author: shaycrowded

sections.description:
Easily embed your fundraising, dues, and event payment collections into your WordPress site with Crowded Collect.

Built for all kinds of nonprofits, from associations to charities, nonprofits embed their payment collections created on the Crowded platform to their websites to keep their donors and payers on their site, while processing payments to fund their activities. Create a Crowded account to create payment collections for your organization or log in to your account to get started.

Embedded Forms

Display a full donation form directly on your page as an inline embed. Customize the height for desktop and mobile to ensure a seamless experience for your donors.

[crowded-collect-widget index="0"]

Donation Buttons with Pop-Up

Add a donation button anywhere on your site. When clicked, it opens your collection in a pop-up overlay – keeping payers and donors on your page.

[crowded-collect-button index="0" label="Donate Now"]

Features

  • No coding required — paste your Collection ID, and you’re good to go
  • Multiple collections — add as many as you need
  • Two embed styles — inline iframe or button-triggered pop-up
  • Responsive — set separate heights for desktop and mobile

How It Works

  1. Install and activate
  2. Go to Settings → Crowded Collect
  3. Paste your Collection ID from the Crowded platform
  4. Copy the generated shortcode
  5. Paste it into any page, post, or widget area

Links

  • Crowded Website
  • Crowded Platform
sections.installation:
1. Upload the crowded-collect-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly through the WordPress screen.
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Crowded Collect to add your Collection IDs and configure embed settings.
